title: Simulation campaign to guarded learning workflow
summary: Turns quality-gated deterministic simulations into scientific datasets, independent surrogate validation, optional PyTorch tensors, applicability decisions, and explicit high-fidelity fallback.

science.statement: Learning begins only after cases, declared quantities, provenance, failures, and an independent validation split are materialized as evidence.

equations.label: scientific dataset
equations.description: Parameters and quantities retain names, bounds, units, shapes, case identity, and evidence.

equations.label: guarded prediction
equations.description: A learned model never silently extrapolates beyond its declared domain.

inputs.name: campaign
inputs.description: Defines reproducible simulations and output contracts before execution.

inputs.name: estimator
inputs.description: Transparent baseline, PyTorch adapter, or compatible external trainer.

outputs.name: ScientificDataset
outputs.description: Successful reviewed cases linked to artifacts and provenance.

outputs.name: SurrogateTrainingRun
outputs.description: Keeps training and independent validation evidence together.

assumptions: Each case uses a fresh or safely reset model.
Output names, shapes, and units are declared before execution.
At least three successful samples exist for split training.
conventions: Failed cases block dataset consumption by default.
Named result quality policies can gate every sample before dataset admission.
PyTorch remains the optional tensor and training runtime.
applicability: Parameter sweeps, surrogate baselines, reduced-order data, and guarded acceleration of supported FEM workflows.
limitations: Case-level scheduler execution uses deterministic plan shards rather than Python threads.
Residual-scale uncertainty is not calibrated epistemic uncertainty.
Automatic arbitrary-mesh neural-operator training is not implemented.

validation_rules: Reject missing, non-finite, or wrong-shaped outputs.
Reject partial campaign data by default.
Reject samples that did not pass the requested quality policy.
Reject silent out-of-domain prediction without fallback.
